title: Energy loss calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes ΔE = (3/4)mg × horizontal displacement from A to B, yielding 27mgR/4.

title: Pressure at point D
description: Essential: Correctly determines N = 13mg/4 by applying work-energy theorem to find v_D and Newton's second law at D.

title: No-detachment condition
description: Essential: Correctly states both conditions: h ≥ 10R OR 24R/7 ≤ h ≤ 40R/7.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem correctly, accounting for both gravitational and electric work along the path.

title: Force analysis at D
description: Important: Recognizes that at point D, the centripetal force is provided by electric force and normal force, with gravity absent (horizontal position).

title: Resultant force analysis
description: Important: For part (3), combines gravity and electric force into a constant resultant force to analyze circular motion conditions.

title: Trigonometric calculations
description: Optional: Correctly uses tan53° = 4/3 and other trigonometric relations for displacement components.

title: Sign error in electric work
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for electric force work (negative for conservative field thinking) instead of positive energy loss.

title: Missing electric force at D
description: Pitfall: Omits electric force in centripetal force equation at point D, treating it as gravity-only scenario.

title: Incomplete detachment conditions
description: Pitfall: Provides only one of the two required ranges for h in part (3).
